'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Stephen Kim LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Stephen Kim]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Something Something Complete
* '''Username:''' raith
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
